verification_status: Secondary sources only. The Nepal Gazette notice and the IRD, SEBON and CDSC pages could not be read (IRD site: ECONNRESET twice; no official page surfaced in search). Re-verify against an official page when one is reachable.

cgt_resident_individual_listed_securitie.applies_to: resident natural person selling SEBON-listed securities; withheld at settlement; institutions pay 10 percent
cgt_resident_individual_listed_securitie.long_term_means: held more than 365 days (exactly 365 days is short term)

periods.note: FY 2082/83 and earlier. Older years may differ; check before using for past sales.

Cabinet decision of 31 Bhadra 2083 (16 Sep 2026), published in the Nepal Gazette on Asoj 5 or 6, 2083. Sources split between 21 and 22 September 2026; 22 September is used. Legal basis cited: section 18(1) of the Economic (Finance) Act 2083. Nepalpress and Annapurna TV printed 3.5 percent for long term: treated as a typo.

open_points: Whether the rate follows the trade date or the settlement date is not stated by the news reports (one advisory site says settlement date).
Loss set-off against other gains was promised in the 21-point plan; one source says it was not in force on 2026-10-20.
Cost basis of bonus shares: one source says zero, one says Rs 100 par. The recorded WACC (MeroShare, kept by CDSC) is what counts; use the user's screen figure.
Whether selling costs reduce the taxable gain is not stated. costs.py taxes the gross gain and reports the tax if costs were deductible.
One advisory site says gains above Rs 40 lakh a year need a return and tax clearance. Single source.

dividend_tax_resident_pct.note: Cash dividend: 5 percent final withholding by the company. Bonus shares: not taxed to the holder at issue; one source says the company pays 5 percent on the bonus.

broker_commission.basis: Applies to the whole trade value, not in bands. Slab edges: up to and including the limit.
broker_commission.note: In force since Jestha 2081 (about 14 May 2024) after a 10 percent cut. Unrounded SEBON figures are 0.306 and 0.243 for the third and fifth slabs; brokers quote 0.31 and 0.24. One source says SEBON has treated the slabs as ceilings since 2025, so a broker may charge less. IPO, FPO and right shares taken directly from the issue carry no commission, SEBON fee or DP charge.

dp_charge_npr.sides_assumed: sell leg counted once here; buy leg is inside the user's WACC
dp_charge_npr.note: Sources disagree on whether it is charged on both legs. Rs 25 either way.

price_tick_npr.note: Assumed from memory, not verified in this session. Used only to round break-even prices. Verify live.
